issue.title: Color-grouped Highlights sidecars cut hard-wrapped quotes at the first line without '>' and render the rest as a Comment
issue.description:
Proposed by the bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5 lander (found while confirming bob-cli-4r live recovery).

In a color-grouped Highlights sidecar (no page headings, `#### Yellow` color headings, `##### YYYY-MM-DD:` date headers), a hard-wrapped quote ends at the first physical line that lacks `>`. The rest of the highlighted text is then rendered as the user's Comment.

Root cause: `parse_sidecar_chunk` (src/native/highlights_ref/sidecar.rs) only applies bare-line quote continuation (`is_quote_continuation_line`) when `linked_page_style` is true. That flag comes only from a linked `[Page N](highlights://...)` page heading. Color-grouped exports have no page heading at all, so `linked_page_style` stays false and every wrap line without `>` becomes comment text. They use the same hard-wrap shape as linked-page exports.

Live read-only repro (athena, 2026-10-24): `~/bob/lib/chat/remote_sase_agents_consolidated.md` second chunk:
```
> Execution host first. Put the always-online server on a private
> tailnet and run the
existing SASE mobile gateway there. Other
> machines submit and monitor work as
...
sase already seems to support launching an agent on remote machine B from local machine A?
```
`~/bob/ref/chat/remote_sase_agents_consolidated.md` renders `> [!quote] Execution host first. Put the always-online server on a private tailnet and run the` and then `> > [!note] Comment existing SASE mobile gateway there. Other > machines submit ...`. Highlighted words show up as Bryan's comment, with stray `>` characters, in Obsidian, `bob ref show`, and the Mac Refs inspector. A parse with the current master build confirms text="...tailnet and run the" and comment="existing SASE mobile gateway there. Other\n> machines ...".

Blast radius today: a read-only scan of ~/bob/lib finds one color-grouped sidecar with quotes (this one; the note's status is abandoned). Any future color-grouped export is affected.

Fix direction: also apply quote continuation to Highlights-export chunks without page headings, i.e. color-grouped sidecars recognized by a color heading or annotation-date header. Keep the boundaries the bob-cli-ba fix established: a blank line, page and annotation-date headers, Comment:/Note: labels, and marker-list fields end the quote. Also strip `>` from continuation lines that resume the quote. The quote text changes, so the remint policy from bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5 (highlight_id_on_quote_fix=remint) applies: expect h-e2d9e4fa6422 to remint and tombstone on the next sync. Add a color-grouped fixture case to tests/fixtures/highlights_ref/color_grouped_sidecar.md or a sibling.

task_type_fields.impact: Highlighted words show up as Bryan's own comment, with stray '>' characters, in Obsidian, bob ref show, and the Mac Refs inspector for every color-grouped export. One live note today.
task_type_fields.repro: Compare ~/bob/lib/chat/remote_sase_agents_consolidated.md (second chunk: '> ...run the' then bare 'existing SASE mobile gateway there. Other') with ~/bob/ref/chat/remote_sase_agents_consolidated.md: the quote stops at 'run the' and the rest renders as '[!note] Comment'. A fixture with a color heading, a date header, and a quote wrapped without '>' reproduces it.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5 lander saw a live ref note render highlighted text as Bryan's Comment. The bob-cli-ba fix covers only linked-page sidecars, so color-grouped exports keep the defect.
